generated_assets.name: Dashboard — EQ Greeting Companion
generated_assets.purpose: EQ character in a calm, friendly greeting pose that sits beside the dashboard greeting text and welcomes the parent.
generated_assets.prompt_details: Recreate ONLY the EQ mascot exactly as it appears in the approved dashboard: same winking expression (left eye closed as the angular chevron, right eye round and open), same triumphant raised fist, same other hand holding the glowing golden lantern, same proportions and colors.

placement.description: To the right of the greeting and headline text block, bottom-aligned with the header section.

generated_assets.alignment: right edge of header content, baseline-aligned with headline
generated_assets.responsive: Scales down to 96px width on small screens; hide below 320px viewport rather than shrinking further.

generated_assets.name: Dashboard — Hero Landscape
generated_assets.purpose: Serene Islamic-inspired environment illustration used as the hero backdrop band of the dashboard: soft rolling hills, distant mosque silhouette with dome and minaret, warm sky, gentle clouds.
generated_assets.prompt_details: Recreate ONLY the hero background environment from the approved dashboard: bright blue sky with soft fluffy white clouds, green rolling hills with trees, soft distant mosque domes and minaret silhouettes on the right side, warm golden-hour lighting. Leave gentle open space center-left where the EQ character is composited separately.

placement.description: Full-width band directly under the header greeting area, behind no interactive elements; progress rings sit below it, not on top of it.

generated_assets.alignment: full-bleed horizontally, top-anchored in the hero band
generated_assets.responsive: Full-bleed at all widths; crop from bottom first; keep mosque silhouettes (right) and open character space (center-left) inside the safe area.

must_include: distant mosque domes/minaret on the right
safe open area for EQ placement

generated_assets.name: Dashboard — Family Quest Card Artwork
generated_assets.purpose: Wide card background artwork for the Family Quest card: a floating island scene with cohesive lighting, sized as a full card background rather than an isolated cutout object.
generated_assets.prompt_details: Recreate the Family Quest card background as one cohesive wide scene, not an isolated cutout object: a floating island with a green grass top and earthy underside sits within a full sky backdrop with soft clouds, a miniature cream-and-teal domed mosque with a golden crescent moon on top stands on the island, a small green flag on a pole planted in the grass bears a golden heart symbol, warm cohesive lighting matching the rest of the approved dashboard.

placement.description: Full card background artwork; Family Quest title, descriptive text and CTA button are native components overlaid on top.

generated_assets.responsive: Full-bleed within the card at all widths; crop from edges first; keep the island and mosque within the safe center 70%.
